purpose: Teach: 出撃/前途/可否/押え/広義/互角/前段/奔走

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新市場に出撃する準備を整えろ
lines.en: Get our company ready for the new market push.
lines.style: Sharp, direct command. Clipped delivery with no softness. Eyes forward. Measured authority — not rushed, not warm. The tone of someone used to being obeyed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の前途は明るいと信じます
lines.en: Yes. I believe our company has a bright future ahead.
lines.style: Respectful but grounded. Steady pace, clear articulation. Not performative earnestness — genuine confidence tempered with professionalism. A pledge, not a plea.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新事業の可否を取締役会で決めろ
lines.en: Have the board decide whether we move forward with this new venture.
lines.style: Firm, instructional. Slight emphasis on the weight of the decision. Pauses fractionally before key words. The tone of delegating responsibility to someone trusted.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。コストを徹底的に押え込みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll keep costs strictly under control.
lines.style: Assured, economical in delivery. No hedging. A promise made quietly. Slight lean forward at 'strictly' — showing he's absorbed the priority. Businesslike but genuine.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 広義のサービス業の動向を見極めろ
lines.en: Watch the broader service industry landscape and tell me what you see.
lines.style: Instructive but not patronizing. Slightly slower pace to emphasize the scope of the task. Weight on 'see' — he wants real insight, not summary. The tone of trusting someone's judgment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。競合と互角に戦える戦略を立てます
lines.en: Yes. I'm developing a strategy to compete with rivals on equal footing.
lines.style: Alert, engaged response. Slight quickening on 'strategy' — showing energy and readiness. Not defensive. The tone of someone already thinking two steps ahead.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、提案の前段でゴールを明確にしろ
lines.en: Before we pitch anything, make sure we're clear on our goals.
lines.style: Measured, foundational. Emphasis on 'before' — this is the prerequisite, not an afterthought. No rush in the delivery. The tone of someone who's seen proposals fail for lack of clarity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新規顧客開拓に奔走しております
lines.en: Yes. We're already out there pursuing new clients.
lines.style: Reassuring through action. Calm, no strain despite the effort implied. 'Pursuing' lands with quiet confidence. The tone of someone showing progress without needing praise for it.
